annotations.title: Set a comment's status, priority, labels or assignee

description: Change how a comment is tracked, the same way the HTMLAnnotate app does: its status (open, in progress, resolved), priority, labels and who it is assigned to. Pass only what should change. Resolving emails everyone in the thread, and assigning emails the person assigned. Labels replace the comment's current labels (up to 3). To only mark a comment done or reopen it, resolve_comment is simpler.

assignee.description: Optional. A teammate or reviewer on this page, by name or email. "none" unassigns it.

labels.description: Optional. The labels the comment should have. An empty list clears them.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

number.description: The comment number as shown by get_comments, like 3 for #3.

name: set_comment_status
